title: Appeal to National Commission
description: Exception to the general rule of appeal

content.general_rule: An appeal shall lie to the National Commission from any order passed in appeal by any State Commission
content.exception: Save as otherwise expressly provided under this Act or by any other law for the time being in force
conditions: the National Commission is satisfied that the case involves a substantial question of law
